svg.title: Inside a single transformer encoder block
svg.desc: Detailed structural diagram of one transformer encoder block showing token embeddings, multi-head self-attention with Q K V projections, residual connections, layer normalization, feed-forward network, and output representations. Annotated with parameter counts and dimensions for BERT-base and DistilRoBERTa.
svg.text: Shared by BERT, RoBERTa, DistilBERT, DistilRoBERTa — only depth (N layers) differs

g.text: Same dim = 768 · richer context than input

svg.text: This block repeats N times. Same architecture — only N, training data, and fine-tuning head differ across the model family.
